freeSpots.name: Rail Trail stroll
freeSpots.idea: Walk the Rail Trail from Bland St toward Atherton Mill and vote on the best mural along the way.

freeSpots.name: Romare Bearden Park at night
freeSpots.idea: Grab a bench facing the skyline after dark. The waterfall wall and city lights do the work.

freeSpots.name: Freedom Park loop
freeSpots.idea: Loop the lake, feed nothing to the ducks, and claim a spot on the hill for a packed picnic.

freeSpots.name: Little Sugar Creek Greenway
freeSpots.idea: Walk or bike the greenway from Midtown toward Freedom Park and stop wherever looks good.

freeSpots.name: Reedy Creek Nature Preserve
freeSpots.idea: Pick a trail you have never done, then swap a 'best moment of the week' at the lake.

freeSpots.name: McGill Rose Garden
freeSpots.idea: Small, quiet, and pretty. Bring a thermos of coffee and take your time.

freeSpots.name: Camp North End wander
freeSpots.idea: Browse the murals and courtyards, then sit by the fire pits if they are lit.

freeSpots.name: NoDa mural walk
freeSpots.idea: Walk N. Davidson and 36th St and photograph each other in front of three murals.

freeSpots.name: Optimist Hall people-watching
freeSpots.idea: Window-shop the stalls and play 'guess their order' from the upstairs railing.

freeSpots.name: Saturday farmers market date
freeSpots.idea: Browse a Saturday morning market, sample what is offered, and plan a dinner you will cook together from what you already have.

freeSpots.name: At-home Charlotte tasting night
freeSpots.idea: Use what you already have: make a mini tasting board, put on a playlist, and play a card game.

freeSpots.name: Backyard movie night
freeSpots.idea: Project or prop a laptop outside, blankets on the grass, popcorn from the pantry.

freeSpots.name: Library book swap date
freeSpots.idea: At the Main Library, each of you picks a book for the other in under 15 minutes. Check hours before you go.

freeSpots.name: Living room trivia night
freeSpots.idea: Steal the brewery format: five rounds, ten questions each, loser does dishes. Pull questions from a free trivia app.

freeSpots.name: Pantry cook-off
freeSpots.idea: Each of you gets 30 minutes and only what is already in the kitchen. Judge on taste and presentation.

freeSpots.name: Optimist Hall rainy-day hang
freeSpots.idea: It is all under one roof, so it works in the rain. Wander, pick a table, and people-watch.

trails.note: Start at E. Carson Blvd for the smoothest stretch. Check for the closure between Poindexter Dr and New Bern St.
